title: rhobound-mcp.config/v1
description: The server's configuration (DEPLOY_AWS.md 14): names to locations. Tools take names, never paths, buckets or prefixes. The engine is run by absolute path after its sha256 is checked (server.engine_mismatch).

path.description: absolute path of the rhobound binary

root.description: dir: the folder laid out as the S3 exporter writes

prefix.description: s3: the prefix, ending in /; held here only, recorded as a digest

captures.description: capture names (stdio mode, and A/B arms) to local folders. A name is also what the server passes to the engine as a fit's --name, so beyond Name it has no empty, . or .. path segment, ext: starts no word of it but the first, and it holds no arn: (at its start, after a character that is not a letter or a digit, or before an AWS partition); a configuration with another name does not load

policies.description: policy names to policy files, under the rule of capture names

fit_ttl_h.description: hours that fit and A/B handles live, and the most an environment's baseline fit may age past the end of its window before it is refused (fit.expired)
